name: Savings Goals
description: Fill piggy bank jars for each goal and see how much to save each month to get there in time.
prompt: A savings goals app with a jar that fills up for each goal, target and deadline, quick buttons to add money, how much to save per month and per week to reach it, and confetti when a goal is reached.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Llena huchas para cada meta y mira cuánto ahorrar cada mes para llegar a tiempo.
